campaign: 02 - Gauge / transport identification: given P, does it fix which residual in one fiber matches which in another?

post_p4_result.theorem: fiber-gauge non-identifiability: two admissible trivializations of the same P giving different surgery kernels cannot both equal one gauge-invariant functional of (K,q,pi)

chain.step: FIBER-AUT (exact O1 automorphism invariance of the scalar B)
chain.theorem: sections related by an exact O1 automorphism preserving q and pi have B_sigma1 = B_sigma2
chain.implementation_note: v0.1 script had a scope bug in binary-quotient composition, fixed in v0.1.1 with no change to protocol or theorem

chain.gauge_closure_theorem: the semantic class 'successive active + autonomous append-only P' is closed under the full fiber gauge group prod_p Sym(A)
chain.transport_equivalence_theorem: trivialization S=A*P <=> coherent fiber transport tau_{p->p'}, up to a global relabeling of A
chain.intervention_lift_theorem: coherent fiber transport <=> intervention-lift family (J_p) satisfying I1-I3; this IS the operational meaning of do(P=p) holding the residual fixed
chain.conclusion: pi alone does not fix the surgery; an explicit fiber-transport / intervention-lift structure is required

failed_simple_fixes: elementary semigroup invariants (rank, fixed points, Green L/R/J, centralizer size) do not select the oracle gauge on P4-A/B
neither min_phi B_phi nor max_phi B_phi is a general rule (oracle = min on P4-A/B, = max on IR10/P3-D/P4-C)
the gauge-free CMI substitute I(S;Y|h(S),U) reproduces IR10/P3-D but not P4-A/B/C

policy.PI-PARTIAL: 1<|B-set|<inf, report exact set or [B-,B+], no tie-break

chain.theorem: a residual signature c:S->C, injective within every fiber and identically-set across fibers, induces a unique coherent intervention-lift family
chain.scope: validates the identification algorithm conditional on a declared auxiliary signature existing; does not show such a signature is derivable from O1 in general

chain.note: no separate prose result note survives in the source repository; private oracle not redistributed; verdict inferred only from the root repository's summary table (finite non-refutation), not independently confirmed in this edition

overall_verdict: identifying P != identifying transport != computing the surgery. Transport is either derived from a declared auxiliary intervention algebra (JID-P5/P6, conditional), or the framework must report the admissible set (PI-PARTIAL) rather than choose an element of it.
